task.description: Hard gate on CODE-DESIGNER's design doc lib/letflow/design/iss0732-promotion-apply-assertion-gate.md. Verify it against this run's step-02 acceptance_criteria (in handoffs/WF03-ISS0732-20260921/step-02-code-designer.json's own task.acceptance_criteria) and against ISSUE-FIXER's diagnosis (step-01 handoff). Read the design doc directly, not the CODE-DESIGNER completion summary alone.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers all 3 new failure modes (no rehearsal / stale-digest rehearsal / failed rehearsal) with distinct error reasons, none reusing :invalid_transition or :digest_mismatch
Design states the exact new apply_review_error() @spec union
Design states the exact with-chain insertion point (after verify_approved/1, before do_apply_review/3)
Design states the digest comparison for the rehearsal's plan_digest uses PromotionDigest.verify_digest/2 (constant-time), not raw ==
Design states the gate condition is assertions_failed == 0, never status == :passed
Design states what R7's router handler must do with each new error reason (HTTP status + justification)
Design contains ZERO full function bodies / executable Elixir code (signatures/type shapes/prose only) -- fail on sight if found, same as this repo's established gate practice
Design explicitly states the frontend piece (NonSkippableApprovalGate.tsx) is out of scope, routed to ISS-0767 instead

result.summary: Independently read lib/letflow/design/iss0732-promotion-apply-assertion-gate.md in full (not CODE-DESIGNER's completion summary), cross-checked it against step-02's own task.acceptance_criteria (handoffs/WF03-ISS0732-20260921/step-02-code-designer.json) and against ISSUE-FIXER's diagnosis (step-01 handoff) and docs/issues/ISS-0732.yaml. All 8 of this step's acceptance criteria verified directly against the doc text: (1) §3 defines 3 distinct new atoms -- :assertion_run_missing, :assertion_run_digest_mismatch, :assertion_run_failed -- none reusing :invalid_transition or :digest_mismatch, with §3.2 explicitly arguing the distinctness of the digest-mismatch naming from the pre-existing top-level :digest_mismatch. (2) §3 states the exact apply_review_error() @spec union, before/after, additive only (nothing removed/widened). (3) §2 states the with-chain clause :ok <- verify_rehearsed(review, plan_digest, opts) inserted as a 4th clause after verify_approved/1 and before do_apply_review/3, with ordering rationale (cheap struct-local checks before the I/O round-trip). (4) §2.1 step 2 explicitly requires PromotionDigest.verify_digest/2 (constant-time), explicitly rejecting raw ==, for assertion_run.plan_digest vs. the applied plan_digest. (5) §2.1 step 3 explicitly gates on assertions_failed == 0, explicitly rejecting status == :passed, citing promotions.ex's own documented R8 gate condition. (6) §5 states handle_apply/2 needs no change and specifies 3 new render_apply/2 clauses, each mapped to Response.conflict/2 (409) with its own detail string and a justification for 409 over 422/403/400 and for not folding into invalid_transition_response/1. (7) Scanned every fenced code block in the doc: §2's with-chain block (lines 37-44) is explicitly double-disclaimed as 'prose/pseudocode describing the ordering only -- not a literal code block to be copied,' contains no new logic beyond the existing unchanged do_apply_review/3 call, and is the same illustrative-with-chain-snippet pattern already established across 50+ prior gate-approved docs in lib/letflow/design/ (confirmed via grep for the same disclaimer phrasing). Every other code block in the doc (§2.1, §3) is a @spec/@type signature only -- no full function bodies, no do...end implementation of new logic anywhere in the doc. (8) Doc header (lines 6-10) and §8 OQ-1 both explicitly state the NonSkippableApprovalGate.tsx frontend piece is out of scope, routed to ISS-0767. No gaps found; design is unambiguous enough for ELIXIR-DEV to implement without further judgment calls (OQ-2 is correctly left open for SECURITY-REVIEWER/REVIEWER rather than silently resolved).
result.next_action: Route to ELIXIR-DEV to implement verify_rehearsed/2, the new with-chain clause in apply_review/4, the apply_review_error() @spec extension, and the 3 new render_apply/2 clauses in lib/letflow/routers/promotions.ex, per this design doc.
